Subject: Your divorce by mutual consent matter - Petition No. 117/2020

Dear Mr. Sethi,

Thank you for meeting us on 24/05/2021 about your dispute with Harpreet Chauhan. As we understand it, the spouses agree on a single payment instead of maintenance.

Our advice is to record the one-time alimony settlement in the consent terms. Please collect income tax returns and the draft consent terms and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of ₹30,60,000.

Regards,
Adv. Aditi Ranganathan
